messages.content: "你能幫我計算三個不同三角形的總面積嗎？第一個三角形的底邊長為15公尺，高度為20公尺。第二個三角形的底邊長為25英呎，高度為30英呎。第三個三角形的底邊長為35英吋，高度為40英吋。我想要每個三角形的面積以它們各自的單位呈現。"

function.name: geometry_area_triangle
function.description: Calculate the area of a triangle. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

base.description: The length of the base of the triangle.

unit.description: The measurement unit for the area. Defaults to square meters.

message.reasoning:
The user wants to calculate the area of three triangles with different units: first in meters, second in feet, third in inches. They want each area in its own unit. So we need to compute area for each triangle using the formula (1/2)*base*height. Then present each area with appropriate unit. We can use the geometry_area_triangle function for each calculation. The function signature expects base, height, and optional unit. For the first triangle, unit defaults to square meters if omitted. But we can specify "square meters". For the second, unit "square feet". Third, unit "square inches".
